scripts.dev: npm run build -w @apree/contracts && npm run build -w @apree/api && node --env-file=.env scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build -w @apree/contracts && npm run build -w @apree/api && npm run build -w @apree/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @apree/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:api
